newsitem.title: USA: Hicks Muse wraps four-station, $160 mln TV buy.
newsitem.headline: Hicks Muse wraps four-station, $160 mln TV buy.

text.p: Hicks, Muse, Tate & Furst Inc said Tuesday it has completed the previously announced acquisition of four television stations from Jupiter/Smith TV Holdings, in a deal valued at about $160 million.

The stations, located in Flint, Mich. (WEYI), Rochester, N.Y. (WROC), Salinas-Monterey, Calif. (KSBW), and Steubenville, Ohio (WTOV), are the first to be acquired by STC Broadcasting Inc a company newly formed by Hicks Muse and STC management led by Robert N. Smith.

Hicks Muse, a private investment firm, said it has committed a minimum of $100 million of equity capital to STC Broadcasting under an initiative to build a television broadcasting company valued at between $500 million and $1 billion.

Smith has been named chief executive officer of STC Broadcasting, which will operate the acquired properties and pursue other middle-market television station investment opportunities, Hicks Muse said.
